claim_reviewed: Original obstruction quotient bound under the retained arithmetic cohomology system; no whole-node claim.

mathematical_checks.finding: Exact sequence and order formula are correct. Forgetting local primitives maps onto the global H2 localization kernel; its kernel is the stated H1 cokernel.

At ordinary places lift zero-cochain primitives. At old places inertia acts trivially, so the allowed cocycle itself vanishes on inertia; a Frobenius value lifts. For a finite module any lifted value defines a continuous procyclic cocycle: choose a period divisible by the action order and the additive exponent. No arbitrary H1 surjectivity is used.

H2 surjectivity first lifts a global class, then a lifted one-cochain corrects to an exact cocycle lift. The local errors are kernel-valued 2-cocycles. Equality of two chosen defects modulo global H2 makes their representative difference lift. Choosing one representative per quotient class therefore gives an injection even without a canonical homomorphism.

The two orientations are both needed. Their composite is t^e; middle exactness gives the first quotient factor H_e, and the reverse map defect bounds the remaining image factor by K2_e. No injectivity of the induced H2 map is assumed.

mathematical_checks.item: three odd constants and auxiliary descent
mathematical_checks.finding: C0 plus C_aux bounds the odd Selmer factor. C_h appears once per ordinary place, not per local degree. The additive-dual bound C_d applies to the global H2 cokernel and appears twice: once in H_e and once in the reverse-sequence defect. Thus C2=C0+C_aux+r_ell*C_h+2*C_d has the stated quantifiers.
Odd rank 2ab, real fixed rank ab and ordinary quotient rank ab give cancellation using sum d_v=d. The coefficient-length-zero, e=0 and e=m cases are included.

coefficients.edge_cases: e=0, e=m, m=0 and empty blocks included
coefficients.negative_control: The finite cochain suite detects failures of global H2 surjectivity or allowed-local-cocycle lifting and does not apply the quotient lemma there.

limits: Arithmetic finiteness, Euler identities, global duality and global H2 right exactness remain retained inputs; this review does not reprove them.
Finite cyclic computations test the algebraic hypotheses, not actual arithmetic duality.
The original W2 cocycle translation is separate from this package.
No Lean build and no RH/GRH whole-node closure is asserted.
